steps.message: qsbar: open the crate-mark panel, change the EQ preset, close it
controls: open Controls (Super+Esc), flip a toggle, close it
launcher: open the launcher, search 'cr ' and close it
gamebar: open the Game Bar and close it
kit: open Kit: let the Beam scan, pick a chip, move a slider
pickers: open the wallpaper picker on Groove and Sheen, close it
dock: move the pointer along the dock and back
